ScarletPitch

What is ScarletPitch?

Hosted by the Innovation, Design, and Entrepreneurship Academy (IDEA), ScarletPitch is a campus-wide pitch competition that celebrates student entrepreneurship. It brings together students from all disciplines and backgrounds to create businesses designed to be a force for good. Compete for cash and prizes, gain mentorship and visibility, and advance to UPitchNJ or the Hult Prize, all while connecting to Rutgers' vibrant entrepreneurial ecosystem.  All ideas welcome!

FAQs

  • Undergraduate and Graduate students enrolled at Rutgers-New Brunswick (part-time or full-time)

  • Teams can consist of 1 to 5 members

  • Each pitch is 5 minutes, followed by a 3-minute Q&A session. Your pitch should address:

    • The problem you're solving
    • The proposed solution
    • Your unique advantage (How is your idea innovative or different)
    • Business model and potential customers
    • Your top competitors

  • A link to applications will be published at the top of this page when they are available

    • ScarletPitch, UPitchNJ, and Hult Prize are three DIFFERENT pitch competitions.
    • UPitchNJ: A statewide competition held in May. One Rutgers team will be chosen at ScarletPitch to represent Rutgers at UPitchNJ.
    • Hult Prize: An international competition with semi-finals in June. One Rutgers team will be selected at ScarletPitch to compete in the Hult Prize semi-finals.
    • ScarletPitch encourages sustainability. The SDGs address global challenges, and most ideas align with one or more of them.
    • If you're unsure which SDG fits your idea, email idea.hatchery@rutgers.edu to schedule a consultation session.

  • Yes! Participation in multiple pitch events is encouraged to gain experience and feedback to advance your idea.

  • A concise, spoken presentation of your idea without slides. Imagine describing your idea during a brief elevator ride—how would you convey it before the person steps off?

  • Yes, participation in ScarletPitch is required for selection to represent Rutgers in UPitchNJ or the Hult Prize.
